verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own AI assistant can 'check your calendar', and the homepage says the AI connects to Calendar so you can automate workflows without leaving your inbox. That covers only AI-mediated viewing of the calendar; there is no documented calendar view, invite responses (RSVP), or event creation. missing for 10: native in-client calendar view, responding to meeting invites, creating calendar events, detailed calendar-integration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client

citations.quote: it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more.
Connect the AI to your Slack, Calendar, Notion, Asana, Hubspot, and more so you can automate workflows without ever leaving your inbox.
